name: Garni Eveline
beschreibung:
Centrally yet quietly located in Ischgl, Garni Eveline welcomes guests with stylish rooms and a nourishing breakfast buffet. It provides a peaceful retreat right in the vibrant heart of the Paznaun valley.

The Silvretta Arena cable cars, boutiques, and gourmet restaurants are just a brief stroll away.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Eveline in Ischgl provides contemporary accommodations within easy walking distance of the ski lifts.
